account.signInText: Sign in to sign up for games and follow your statistics.
account.nicknameHint: Shown in ratings and sign-up lists. 2–32 characters.
account.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.loginMethodsHint: Link accounts to sign in to one profile with any of them.
account.linkError: Linking failed. This account may already belong to another profile.
account.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it below or click the link in the email.
account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
account.invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired.
account.botHint: Reminders 3 hours before a game, a message when a seat opens up, and sign-up right in Telegram.

games.empty: No upcoming games yet. Follow our Telegram.
games.queueHint: Pass holders go first. Confirmation comes on Monday; with 20 players there's a second table.

admin.title: Club admin
admin.noAccess: You have no role in any club.
admin.newGameHint: One-off game (corporate, special event). Regular games are created automatically. A new game starts as a draft — check it and open sign-ups.
admin.created: Game created as a draft. Check it and set the status to “Open”.

errors.full: The game is full — the player stays on the waitlist. Increase the seats.
errors.noPlayer: No player with this nickname. Ask them to sign in and set it in their account.
errors.bot: Telegram rejected the request. Check the bot token and that the bot is a channel admin.
errors.matchNumber: A game with this number already exists.

admin.teamHint: The player must first sign in and set a nickname. A host runs games and sign-ups; an admin also manages venues and tournaments.
admin.botHint: Connects @mafiaclub_prague_bot to the website: sign-ups, reminders, notifications. Needed once (and again after moving to mafiacl.com).
admin.queueRules: Pre-registration until {until}: pass holders go first. Then the first 10 get confirmed (in the morning at 09:00), the rest go to the waitlist. {final} — final call: 20+ → a second table, fewer than 10 → you get a message and decide.
admin.queueFinalized: The final call has passed; normal capacity-based sign-up from here.
admin.membershipsHint: A pass gives priority for Tuesday mini-tournaments and covers the evening fee. You can issue one to someone not on the site yet — by nickname; priority starts once you link it to their account.
admin.membershipUnlinked: Pass saved under the nickname. Once the player signs up on the site, link it to their account to activate priority.
admin.titlesHint: ⭐ Premier League season champion and 👑 MafiaCL Kings winner — the badge shows next to the nickname on the site and in bot posts. ⚜️ goes automatically to the latest mini tournament winner. You can record it for a nickname even if the player isn't on the site yet.
admin.prizesHint: Cash prizes for players: season final, MafiaCl Arena rounds, etc. Shown on the player page and in the hall of fame.

match.newMatchHint: Seating comes from confirmed sign-ups: table 1 — the first 10, table 2 — the next 10. You can change it on the game screen.
match.conflict: The game was changed from another device — loaded the latest version.
match.offline: No connection — the action will be saved when you're back online. Keep this page open.

err.lineup: Roles don't add up: 6 civilians, a sheriff, 2 mafia and a don are needed.
err.noBestMove: Only the first player killed at night has a best move.

match.hintNight0: Tap a player to change their role: civilian → mafia → don → sheriff. Then “Start day”.
match.hintDay: Tap a player to nominate (or un-nominate). “!” is a foul; the fourth one removes the player.

hint.shot: Tap the player the mafia shoots, or “Miss”.
hint.best: Best move: mark up to three numbers named by the first killed player.

match.tie: Tie: {seats}. Re-speech or a vote to lift everyone.
match.bestMoveHint: First killed: {seat}. {name}. Mark the numbers they named.

suggest.civilians: All mafia are out — civilians win.
suggest.mafia: Mafia equal the civilians — mafia wins.

match.bestMoveSummary: Best move by player {seat}: {picks} — black guessed: {hits}.

finishErr.conflict: The game was changed from another device — reload the page.
finishErr.range: Bonus from −5 to 5, penalty from 0 to 5.

match.reopened: Game reopened. Undo the last “Finish” step, fix it and save the result again.
match.showRoles: Show roles on the stream layer
match.streamHint: Add the link to OBS as a “Browser” source. The layer shows the current game at this table. Only show roles with a stream delay.
match.whoVotes: Who votes for {seat}. {name}? Mark the numbers.

player.metaDescription: {nick}'s stats at MafiaCL: {games} games, {wins} wins, points and roles.
player.redVotesLine: As a civilian votes for black: {pct} ({n} votes)

rating.empty: No rated games played this season yet.
rating.note: Counts rated games from the electronic sheet for players with a site account. Sheriff and mafia — wins / games in the role. BM — best move points. “+N” next to games — final games.
rating.formulaSum: Rating is the sum of game points.
rating.formulaWinrate: Rating = win points × win rate + bonuses + best move − penalties.
rating.threshold: Ranked from {pct} % of the season's games: currently {n} games. Others are listed below in grey.
rating.final: Final on {date}: top {size} play, final games count ×{coef}.
rating.prize: Prize pool now: {sum} Kč ({ppg} Kč per game + {ppe} Kč per mini tournament).

hall.empty: Empty for now — titles and prizes are added in the admin panel.
hall.legend: ⭐ — Premier League season champion, 👑 — MafiaCL Kings winner, ⚜️ — mini tournament wins (since season V, from the electronic sheet).
